title: Juicy Venezuelan Chicken Liver Skewers
description: A traditional Venezuelan dish featuring chicken liver, infused oil, and high protein, cooked to perfection in a bamboo steamer.

ingredients.name: chicken liver
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into bite sized pieces

instructions: Preheat the bamboo steamer to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, onion, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken liver to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken liver onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers in the bamboo steamer and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the liver is cooked through.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro.
Let the skewers rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
Serve with your choice of sides, such as rice, beans, or roasted vegetables.
Garnish with lemon wedges, if desired.
